editorNote: NASA awards and Google chips lifted two holdings, analysts split on Alibaba, and gold and bitcoin items rounded out the day. Every item rests on headlines alone, so details are limited to what the outlets reported.

stories.headline: SpaceX and Rocket Lab jump as NASA hands out $10 billion in Moon Base awards, Yahoo Finance reports
stories.summary: A Yahoo Finance headline says SpaceX and Rocket Lab shares rose sharply as NASA distributed $10 billion in Moon Base awards. A separate headline says Rocket Lab was up 9% ahead of its earnings report. The headlines give no award-level detail.
stories.whyItMatters: Rocket Lab is a watchlist holding, and the headlines tie its move to a large NASA award round and an upcoming earnings report.

sourceLinks.title: SpaceX, Rocket Lab blast higher as NASA hands out $10 billion in Moon Base awards - Yahoo Finance
Rocket Lab Jumps 9% Ahead of Earnings, AST SpaceMobile Surges 11% on Japan Satellite Venture With Rakuten; SpaceX Rises 6% - 24/7 Wall St.

stories.headline: Alphabet stock rises as Google adds two new TPU variants, Yahoo Finance UK says
stories.summary: A Yahoo Finance UK headline links a rise in Alphabet shares to Google adding two new TPU variants. An Investing.com headline separately asks why the stock is rallying today.
stories.whyItMatters: Alphabet is a watchlist holding; the headlines connect today's gain to Google's custom-chip product news.

stories.whyItMatters: Duolingo is a watchlist holding, and a change to its subscription lineup is a disclosed product decision.

stories.headline: Alibaba: Goldman Sachs cuts its target to $177 while Aletheia Capital raises its own on AI cloud strength
stories.summary: A Moomoo headline says Goldman Sachs kept its Buy rating on Alibaba but cut its target price to $177. An Investing.com headline says Aletheia Capital raised its target citing AI cloud strength.
stories.whyItMatters: Two analyst target changes pointed in opposite directions on the same watchlist stock on the same day.
